themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents that autonomously perform research tasks, from data collection and analysis to task execution and problem-solving.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Focuses on specific AI-powered tools designed to assist in various aspects of research, including analysis, data handling, and workflow optimization.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, such as research papers, meeting notes, or user feedback, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Highlights AI tools that aid developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, accelerating the software development lifecycle.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Explores the research and implications of using AI chatbots for user interaction, information retrieval, and conversational interfaces.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is being used to inform, generate, and streamline the design process, from concept to high-fidelity prototypes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines the effects of AI on jobs, skills, and the future of work, including research on job displacement and creation.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles about the creation and use of AI-generated personas or data to simulate real users for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in streamlining and enhancing the process of testing the usability of products and services.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is employed to extract actionable insights from customer data, understand behavior, and personalize experiences.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
